title: ReviewsEntitySplitResult
description: reviews.entity-split-result@1: the answer of reviews.entity.split on OpenVibe.Reviews: POST /api/v1/entities/:ref/split → { link, entity, from, signals } — the ended merged_into link, the entity (active again), the entity it was merged into and the ids of the signals that went back with it. Both aggregates are recomputed and a summary that cited those signals is flagged with a pending revision. Emits reviews.entity.split.
